name: Hex
summary: Data workspace combining notebooks, conversational analytics, dashboards and data apps.
description: Hex is a collaborative data platform where analysts work in SQL and Python notebooks, business users ask questions in natural language, and teams publish dashboards and interactive data apps. It manages semantic context for AI answers. A Community plan is free; Professional costs $36 per editor per month and Team $75 per editor per month with a 14-day trial; compute beyond small sizes is billed per hour.

howToUse.title: Open Hex
howToUse.description: Open Hex and choose Get started for free, or Request a demo.

howToUse.title: Analyze in a notebook
howToUse.description: Open a notebook and do the analysis in SQL and Python. Hex is a collaborative data platform where analysts work this way.

howToUse.title: Ask in natural language
howToUse.description: Have a business user ask questions in natural language. Hex manages semantic context so those AI answers stay tied to the team's data.

howToUse.title: Publish, then compare plans
howToUse.description: Publish dashboards and interactive data apps for the team. Community costs nothing. Professional is $36 for each editor every month. Team is $75 for each editor every month and includes a 14-day trial. Extra compute, past the small sizes, is billed by the hour.
